brand_identity.vibe: A perfect amalgam of premium consumer brand sensibility and healthcare. Avoids clinical heaviness. Functions like a wellness lifestyle brand.
brand_identity.theme_preference: Light mode by default (nature/wellness relates to light), dark mode optional but should use deep slate rather than pure black.

typography.strategy: The 'Old Money Tech' Pairing. Mix of serif and sans-serif to create an editorial, non-sterile feel.

headings.usage: Use for H1, H2, and major numbers (like confidence scores).

body.usage: Use for all body text, UI elements, and medical descriptions.

rules: H1 (Hero): text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tight leading-none.
Line Height: Tight (leading-none) for headers, Loose (leading-relaxed) for body.
typography.install_instructions: Add Google Fonts imports for Playfair Display and Manrope to index.css or index.html.

colors.strategy: Archetype: Organic & Earthy meets High-Contrast. Subverting standard medical teal into a sophisticated 'Sea Glass' green-blue, paired with deep navy and bone white.
rules: Update tailwind.config.js and index.css with these HSL values.
Never use pure black or pure gray. Always tint neutrals.
Avoid #1B93A4 (Teal Green) for primary dashboard components, use soft Sea Glass instead.

landing_page.hero: Max overlay opacity: bg-black/40. Image must breathe. Typography must overlap slightly to create depth.

dashboard.strategy: High Density Grid, Modular UI, F-Pattern Prioritization.
rules: Top-left must contain the 'North Star' (e.g., most recent diagnosis).
Every pixel utilized, use h-full on children.
Solid surfaces. NO Glassmorphism for health data to prevent visual refraction.
Widgets use 'Clay & Crisp' Neumorphism: flat background matching parent exactly, 1px border-border, subtle ambient shadow.

layouts.spacing: Generous Spacing. p-6 or p-8 for cards. p-12 to p-24 for page sections. Containers with borders must have internal padding to prevent collision.

components.buttons: Pill-shaped or rounded-lg with clear hover states (translate-y-[-1px], shadow-md).
components.symptom_entry: Multi-select Command palette + Checkbox groups. Implement search + manual entry. Must include checkboxes for common symptoms: Fever, Cough, Headache, Vomiting, Chest Pain, Fatigue, Sore Throat, Body Pain, Nausea, Diarrhea, Shortness of Breath.
components.diagnosis_card: Actionable 'Next Best Action' layout. Include: disease name (Large Serif), confidence bar, causes, OTC medicines, home remedies, diet, precautions, when to visit doctor, emergency warning.
components.report_history: Clean table or dense list (Shadcn Table/ScrollArea). Must include view, delete, and search functionality.
components.dashboard: Patient Dashboard must include health stats summary cards, recent reports, and quick link to new diagnosis.
components.medical_disclaimer: Banner at the top or sticky bottom. Muted background, high contrast text.
components.icons: Use @phosphor-icons/react for Duotone weight. Run: yarn add @phosphor-icons/react

surfaces_and_visual_enhancers.headers: Solid Background with a hard bottom border for medical dashboards. No transparent headers.
surfaces_and_visual_enhancers.cards: Subtle roundness (max 8px border-radius), flat off-white background, 1px delicate inner stroke, soft shadow.
surfaces_and_visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle grain texture overlay on the landing page to kill digital flatness.

rules: Hover states for all interactive elements (transition: transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease).
Entrance animations: Staggered fade-up for diagnosis results and report history list.

image_urls.description: A clean, modern medical examination room with a patient chair.
image_urls.category: Landing Page Hero Background or 'About Us' section

image_urls.description: A calm room with a desk.

image_urls.category: Auth pages split-screen background or decorative card backgrounds.

media.rules: No placeholder URLs. Use provided images. Ensure text overlay on images has adequate contrast (bg-black/40 overlay).

accessibility.contrast: APCA preferred. Normal text min 4.5:1. Interactive elements 3:1.
accessibility.focus: Focus states must have HIGHER contrast than default (e.g., focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary).
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., data-testid='symptom-submit-button', data-testid='diagnosis-confidence').

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid 'AI slop' aesthetic.
Since the project uses .js files, ensure all React components and Shadcn components are implemented in .js/.jsx, not .tsx. Do not output TypeScript.
Do not make generic centered layouts. Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Do not use dark colors as gradients.
Never apply 'transition: all'. Explicitly state transitions.
Never center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; } is banned).
Use modern button styles (pill-shaped or crisp 8px rounded) with interaction animations.
Never use AI assistant emojis for icons. Use Phosphor Icons.
Prioritize Shadcn components in src/components/ui but customize them per the color and border rules.
Do NOT use HTML-based components for advanced user interactions (dropdown, calendar, toast).
Implement a theme toggle (Light/Dark). Light is primary for clinical trust.
Ensure the Medical Disclaimer is prominently visible but non-intrusive.
